protocol.description: What the compositor tells shell-ui and what shell-ui asks of it beyond the standard protocols (ADR-002, roadmap M5.3). Private: the two ship together in one image, so the interface grows within version 1 until the first public release. Not an extension API.

interface.name: edel_shell_v1

description.summary: the shell's link to the compositor

interface.description: Bound once by shell-ui. The compositor sends the shown workspace's policy when bound and whenever it changes.

request.name: toggle_policy
request.description: The other policy for the shown workspace only, as Super+T does; the system file is left as it is.

event.name: policy
event.description: How the shown workspace places its windows.
